title: Busting Myths: "Pay off Debt - Your Birth Certificate is Worth Millions"
summary: DebtBytes busts the birth-certificate secret Treasury account myth: no such account exists, fake payments get reversed, and users face fees and prosecution.

assertions.quote: the birth certificate does not pre-pay your debts okay
there is no secret account that you can use to pay your bills
people are going to jail and their all cap's name is going with them
it's reversed and now you owe and plus a late fee

verdicts.note: Billing systems can post an item before it clears; bogus drafts are then returned and late fees apply.

assertions.quote: it's a big problem you're creating for yourself if you follow them
having gone to jail for fraud issuing site drafts fraudulent instruments
the federal reserve doesn't have accounts for individuals they only have accounts for member banks

verdicts.note: Federal Reserve Banks offer accounts to depository institutions and some government bodies, not to individuals.
